supabase.description: Supabase database management - RLS, tables, functions, observability

vercel.description: Vercel project management - deployments, env vars, domains

github.description: GitHub integration - issues, PRs, repo management

sentry.description: Sentry error tracking and performance monitoring

brevo.description: Brevo email marketing and transactional email

instructions.setup: Run 'npm install -g @supabase/mcp-server-supabase @vercel/mcp-server @github/mcp-server-github @cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare @sentry/mcp-server @brevo/mcp-server @opencode/mcp-server' to install all MCP servers
instructions.env_vars: Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN, VERCEL_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, BREVO_API_KEY in your environment
